svg.title: Q4 crowded portfolio
svg.desc: Risk-return view. Independent baseline: 50% lose money, median outcome +1. Shared-outcome stress: 51% lose money, median outcome −167. The horizontal axis is odds of success; the vertical axis is per-bet P50 expected value. Implied-certainty zones cover odds ranges wholly at or below 10%, or wholly at or above 90%.
svg.text: PER-BET P50 EV · BOTH PORTFOLIO CONDITIONS SHOWN · RANGES ARE P10–P90 FROM 4,000 SEEDED RUNS
